headline: US judge approves Bayer's $7.025 billion settlement to close Roundup herbicide cases
summary: A US judge approved Bayer's $7.025 billion settlement to resolve Roundup herbicide cancer claims. The deal is described as one of the largest class settlements in US history and paves the way for tens of thousands of victims to receive compensation.
why: Bayer is a German pharmaceutical and crop science group, and Roundup litigation has been a major long-running liability for its shares and balance sheet.

impacts.name: Bayer
impacts.why: Court approval of the settlement resolves a major Roundup liability for Bayer, though the cost and its effect on finances are not stated in the input.
